scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Karya Prashikshan Yojana (CM's Apprenticeship Scheme)
department: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: On-the-job apprenticeship/internship scheme for Maharashtra youth with a monthly stipend, aimed at improving employability.
benefits: Monthly stipend during a structured internship placement with a registered establishment, amount varying by qualification level.
eligibility: Registered on the state employment portal
application_steps: Register on the Maharashtra skill/employment portal
Get matched to a participating establishment
